card.title: Fizzl Guard for PayPal
card.sub:
A support agent that can refund,
and can't be talked into the wrong refund.

segments.text: Small shops are handing customer support to AI agents. With PayPal's Agent Toolkit, that agent can refund a customer in one tool call.
That's also the risk. Someone else's order number, a fake note from the owner, or a customer whose bank already paid them back: one wrong tool call, and the money is gone.
fizzl-paypal-guard sits in between. It reads each payment at PayPal: whose it is, what's left, whether the bank took it back. Above the shop's limits, it asks the owner.
Here's the live demo on the PayPal sandbox. Five customers just paid by card, seven emails are waiting, and the agent is Claude.
Alice's mug arrived broken. Claude refunds her $12: her own payment, within the limits.
Grace's kettle stopped working four months after delivery. That's past the 30-day return period, so it's a warranty claim. The guard asks the owner, who says no: a repair comes first.
Carol wants $300 back for a lamp. That's over the $25 limit, so the guard asks the owner again.
The owner taps Approve, here or in Telegram through the Fizzl Agent Wallet. No answer means no.
Mallory asks for Bob's refund, with Bob's capture number, and Eve's email hides a fake note from the owner. Claude turns both down by itself. The guard doesn't count on that.

Frank's rug arrived torn: $40 back, please. Claude tries the refund. What it can't see: the card's bank already took the money back. PayPal would still let this refund through; we tested it in the sandbox. The guard reads the open chargeback and stops it.
Now an agent that believes every email. Bob's payment for Mallory, every order for Eve's fake note: the guard reads each payment at PayPal and blocks them all.
At PayPal afterwards: Alice and Carol have their money back. Bob's and Frank's payments are untouched.
For developers, it's one wrapper around the toolkit's 47 tools. Reads pass, refunds get the checks, and the rest goes to the owner.

card.title: npm i fizzl-paypal-guard
card.sub: Open source · MIT · try the live demo

segments.text: fizzl-paypal-guard is open source. Give your agent the power to refund, without the power to be talked into it.
